profile.spectrumBodyHint: How heavy the wine feels in your mouth
profile.spectrumTanninHint: The drying, gripping sensation from grape skins
profile.spectrumSweetnessHint: How much residual sugar the wine has
profile.spectrumAcidityHint: How fresh and crisp the wine tastes
profile.spectrumBodyExplain: Body is how heavy or light a wine feels in your mouth. Light wines are refreshing and delicate, like Pinot Noir. Bold wines are rich and full, like Cabernet Sauvignon.
profile.spectrumTanninExplain: Tannins create a drying, gripping sensation in your mouth. Smooth wines feel silky and easy to drink. Tannic wines have more structure and pair well with rich food.
profile.spectrumSweetnessExplain: Ranges from bone-dry (no residual sugar) to sweet (dessert-like). Most red wines are dry; Riesling and Moscato are examples of sweeter styles.
profile.spectrumAcidityExplain: Acidity makes wine taste fresh and lively. Soft wines feel rounder and mellow. Acidic wines are crisp and zesty, great with food.
profile.overallStyleExplain: The general character of wines you enjoy — the vibe and experience you're drawn to.
profile.bodyStructureExplain: How heavy or light your preferred wines feel. Structure includes tannins and acidity — the wine's backbone.
profile.fruitProfileExplain: The fruit flavors you tend to enjoy — from bright red berries to dark plums and tropical fruits.
profile.styleNotesExplain: Beyond fruit: oak, vanilla, spice, earth, and minerality. These notes shape the wine's complexity.
profile.recommendedGrapesExplain: Grape varieties that produce wines matching your taste. Look for these on wine labels.
profile.recommendedRegionsExplain: Wine regions known for producing styles you enjoy. A great starting point when browsing wine shops.
profile.whatToAvoidExplain: Based on your preferences, these styles might not suit your palate.
profile.summaryExplain: A personalized overview of your wine personality — like advice from a sommelier friend.

guide.title: App Guide
guide.subtitle: Everything you need to get the most out of WineJourney.
guide.featuresIntro: WineJourney helps you discover, collect, and enjoy wine — with an AI sommelier by your side. Here's what you can do.
guide.feature_search_desc: Scan a wine label with your camera or search by name. Get detailed tasting notes, ratings, and a personal match score that shows how well it fits your taste.
guide.feature_sommelier_desc: Your AI wine advisor. Ask for food pairings, discover new wines based on your taste, or get a recommendation for tonight's dinner.
guide.feature_cellar_desc: Organize your collection in a customizable wine rack. See readiness heatmaps, track drinking windows, and manage your inventory with a visual overview.
guide.feature_wishlist_desc: Save wines you want to try. When you buy one, mark it as purchased and it moves straight to your cellar — with an option to place it in your rack.
guide.feature_profile_desc: Your evolving wine personality. The app learns what you love across reds, whites, and more, and refines every recommendation over time.
